notes.title: A few bugfixes and a new feature
notes.content:
A new update is available since Nov. 17, this update fixes a few bugs including and annoying bug that allowed Plasma balls to drift out of the cell and a bug that prevented Pyramid laser weapon to fire in more than one direction.

Additionally there's a new feature, now the radar shows if the enemies are above or below given the actual heading of the ship.

notes.title: New Update, New Ship
notes.content:
New update brings some minor bugfixes, the most important being Taurus engine sound clipping is corrected.

Also a new ship is available for unlock!
Chariot features a high DPS laser gun, higher damage, but more difficult to aim, so be careful!
